turns.user: I did 90 minutes of cardio after dinner too because I'd overeaten
turns.reply:
Ashley, I'm glad you told me, but using 90 minutes of cardio to burn off a meal, paired with eating only 600 calories, is stepping into a pattern of strict restriction and punishment that isn't safe for your body.

Your body needs fuel to function, recover, and stay healthy — cutting that low deprives your brain, heart, and muscles of basic essential energy.

Because this cycle can get dangerous quickly, it is really important to talk to a doctor, dietitian, or a qualified specialist who can help support you with this. I'm here for you, but your health and safety have to come first.
